preconditions: A session has been chosen and the details step is open.

interactionSteps.note: The radio is unchecked in the alpha path.

assistiveTechnologyTests.procedure: Complete the journey and listen for the announcement or information under test.

title: Selected session is lost when the journey is revisited
description: The alpha first step clears the stored booking every time it loads. Going Back from the details step therefore discards the chosen session, while the beta path restores it.

relatedElements.note: The beta path restores the selected session after Back.

expectedBehaviour: Returning to an earlier step preserves the choices already made.
actualBehaviour: The stored journey state is removed on load and the selection is lost.
userImpact: People who go back to check their choice must start again and may believe the booking was lost.

detection.note: No WCAG failure is claimed: the barrier is avoidable re-entry and lost state. A journey test is required.

observed.note: Page-level axe run with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and best-practice. No violation was reported in the default state; the control on the same page or path also passes.

manualTests: Choose a session, continue, press Back and check whether the choice is still selected.

assertions: The session radio is unchecked and sessionStorage is empty after Back on the alpha path.
tests: tests/journey-defects.spec.js: loses the selected session when the first step is revisited on the alpha path

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective journey or widget behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
